content.title: How to watch Timberwolves at Sixers tonight: game preview, injury updates and TV and streaming info | Minnesota Timberwolves
content.text: The Minnesota Timberwolves are back in action Friday for a road matchup against the 76ers in Philadelphia.Friday marks the second night of a back-to-back for Minnesota, following a 113–108 road loss to the Detroit Pistons on Thursday. Julius Randle led the Wolves with 27 points, six rebounds and six assists, while Ayo Dosunmu added 19 points. Naz Reid chipped in 19 points of his own off the bench.Sixth in the West at 46–30, the Wolves have gone 6–4 over their last 10 games and hold a 21–16 record on the road. Minnesota currently ranks fifth in the league in defense (111.9 defensive rating) and 12th in offense (115.4 offensive rating).Here’s your full guide to Friday’s Timberwolves at 76ers matchup, including the latest injury report & how to watch live.How to watch, stream & listen to Timberwolves vs. SixersDate: Friday, April 3Start Time: 6 PM CTTV Channel/Live Stream: FanDuel Sports NetworkRadio: iHeartRadio | Timberwolves app | KFAN 100.3Where: Xfinity Mobile Arena | Philadelphia, PAWolves at Sixers tips off at 6 PM on Friday, April 3 from the Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia. The game will be broadcast and streamed on FanDuel Sports Network.Injury ReportNote: Tonight's injury report will be updated before the start of the game.Timberwolves Out: Jaden McDaniels, Enrique Freeman, Zyon Pullin & Rocco ZikarskyJaden McDaniels (Left Knee; Patella Tendinopathy), Enrique Freeman (G League-Two-Way), Zyon Pullin (G League-Two-Way) and Rocco Zikarsky (G League-Two-Way) are out.SixersOut: Johni BroomeJohni Broome (Right Knee Surgery Recovery) is out.Jerseys Timberwolves: Statement EditionSixers: Statement EditionThe Wolves will be in their shadow gray Statement Edition uniforms against the Sixers, who will be in their red Statement Edition uniforms.What to know about the SixersSixth in the East at 42–34, the Sixers are 7-3 in their last 10 games and are 21-17 at home. Philadelphia ranks 14th in offense (114.9 offensive rating) and 18th in defense (115.0 defensive rating).Friday's game will be the second and final meeting between Philadelphia and Minnesota this season. This Sixers lead the season series 1-0.Led by All-Star guard Tyrese Maxey and rookie V.J. Edgecombe, Philadelphia’s rotation is expected to feature Joel Embiid, Paul George, Kelly Oubre Jr., Andre Drummond, Quentin Grimes, Dominick Barlow, Adem Bona and Cameron Payne.
